editorial: You might expect a lavish union to begin with sweet romance, yet this thriller erupts into a razor‑sharp betrayal. You will find its unsettling setting flips the honeymoon into a claustrophobic maze, where silence is as menacing as any blade. Phoenix lures you in with a haunting monologue‑driven performance that turns every glance into a question. You belong to fans who relish tension that turns morality into a twisted labyrinth. A few pacing hiccups in the middle let the heartbeat stall.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
